Orb — Shareable Artifacts for Hermes & OpenClaw

# Turn your agent's ideas into shareable artifacts.

An artifact is a self-contained, interactive thing your agent makes — a webpage, doc, or diagram — that lives at its own shareable link, ready to view, comment on, and refine. Built for Hermes and OpenClaw, and any skill-compatible agent.

Create a Q1 revenue dashboard for the APAC region

Built your dashboard with regional breakdown and YoY comparison. art.byorb.app/v/a3f9c2d1

Applied 2 comments — changed bars to blue and added a total row. Same link.

## One message to Hermes or OpenClaw

Paste this into Hermes, OpenClaw, or any skill-compatible agent. It installs the Orb artifacts skill and walks you through setup.

Install the Orb artifacts skill for me: byorb.app/install.md

## From prompt to shareable artifact

Your agent creates the artifact. Orb hosts it. You share the link. No extra tools, no copy-paste.

1.

Install Orb in Hermes or OpenClaw

Paste one message into Hermes, OpenClaw, or any skill-compatible agent. It installs the Orb skill and handles the rest.

2.

Ask your agent to create an artifact

Say "create a dashboard" or "make this interactive". The agent calls Orb and gets back a hosted artifact link.

3.

Get a private link, share when ready

Every artifact is private by default. Make it public to share — anyone with the link can open it, no account needed, and save their own copy.

4.

Refine with feedback

Leave comments directly on the artifact. Tell your agent "apply my artifact comments" — it fetches them and updates in place.

## Every kind of artifact your agent can build.

Your agent writes HTML, so it can build almost any artifact — dashboards, docs, slides, landing pages, interactive tools. All hosted instantly.

Dashboards & Reports

Revenue breakdowns, KPI trackers, analytics views — all interactive and live.

Documents & Guides

Formatted docs, onboarding guides, SOPs, changelogs — beautifully rendered.

Presentations & Tools

Pitch decks, calculators, interactive demos — anything that runs in a browser.

Prototypes

Quick MVPs, interactive mockups, POCs — ship ideas before writing backend code.

## Free to start. Free to share.

All artifact types · 10 saved artifacts · Private & public sharing · Comments & feedback · 7-day TTL on unsaved
